events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents Nicoletta Todesco's The Cockroach Diary on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 7:30 PM, with doors at 6:30 PM. The venue describes the work as a song cycle for voice, classical guitar and electric guitar and a one-woman operetta released in 2025. For this National Sawdust presentation, the work is reimagined as an immersive audiovisual experience with visuals by Xuan. The performance is seated. National Sawdust identifies Todesco as a Brooklyn-based guitarist and composer noted for singing while performing classical guitar. The venue's exact event page links to an authorized AudienceView Professional purchase destination. No stable public face-value ticket price is exposed on the verified text surfaces, so no price is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the performance architecture, not name recognition. Todesco sings while moving between classical and electric guitar inside a one-woman operetta that already treats the guitar as both instrument and dramatic voice; at National Sawdust, Xuan's visuals turn that song cycle into an immersive stage environment. The combination of instrumental difficulty, storytelling, noise and projected space gives the live version a reason to exist beyond simply reproducing the 2025 record. If experimental songcraft and instrumental theater are in your lane, actively make room for it.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play, build the Brooklyn evening around National Sawdust. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make a dedicated overnight run solely for this performance.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante es la arquitectura de la función, no el nombre por sí solo. Todesco canta mientras pasa de la guitarra clásica a la eléctrica dentro de una opereta de una sola intérprete donde la guitarra funciona a la vez como instrumento y voz dramática; en National Sawdust, las imágenes de Xuan convierten ese ciclo de canciones en un espacio escénico inmersivo. La mezcla de dificultad instrumental, narración, ruido y espacio proyectado le da a la versión en vivo una razón propia para existir más allá de reproducir el disco de 2025. Si te atraen la canción experimental y el teatro instrumental, sí le haría espacio activamente.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego, armaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de National Sawdust. Desde el DMV la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir a Nueva York en vez de hacer un viaje con noche fuera únicamente por esta función.
